SELECT io.id, io.inbound_order_no AS inboundOrderNo, io.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, io.inbound_type AS inboundType, io.inbound_status AS status,
COALESCE(item_summary.plan_qty, 0) AS planQty, COALESCE(item_summary.received_qty, 0) AS receivedQty, COALESCE(item_summary.putaway_qty, 0) AS putawayQty,
u.real_name AS creatorName,
io.gmt_create AS createdTime, io.gmt_modified AS updatedTime, io.remark
FROM inbound_order io
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = io.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = io.created_by
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inbound_order_id, SUM(plan_qty) AS plan_qty, SUM(received_qty) AS received_qty, SUM(putaway_qty) AS putaway_qty FROM inbound_order_item GROUP BY inbound_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.inbound_order_id = io.id
ORDER BY io.gmt_create DESC, io.id DESC

SELECT io.id, io.inbound_order_no AS inboundOrderNo,
io.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,
io.inbound_type AS inboundType, io.inbound_status AS status,
COALESCE(item_summary.plan_qty, 0) AS planQty, COALESCE(item_summary.received_qty, 0) AS receivedQty, COALESCE(item_summary.putaway_qty, 0) AS putawayQty,
io.created_by AS createdBy, u.real_name AS creatorName,
io.gmt_create AS createdTime, io.gmt_modified AS updatedTime,
io.remark
FROM inbound_order io
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = io.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = io.created_by
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inbound_order_id, SUM(plan_qty) AS plan_qty, SUM(received_qty) AS received_qty, SUM(putaway_qty) AS putaway_qty FROM inbound_order_item WHERE inbound_order_id = #{id} GROUP BY inbound_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.inbound_order_id = io.id
WHERE io.id = #{id}

SELECT i.id, i.inbound_order_id AS inboundOrderId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.plan_qty AS planQty, i.received_qty AS receivedQty, i.putaway_qty AS putawayQty
FROM inbound_order_item i
WHERE i.inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId}
ORDER BY i.id ASC

SELECT ro.id,
ro.receipt_order_no AS no,
ro.receipt_status AS status,
ro.receiver_id AS receiverId,
u.real_name AS receiver,
COALESCE(item_summary.received_qty, 0) AS qty,
ro.received_time AS time,
ro.gmt_create AS createdTime,
ro.remark
FROM receipt_order ro
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = ro.receiver_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT receipt_order_id, SUM(received_qty) AS received_qty FROM receipt_order_item GROUP BY receipt_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.receipt_order_id = ro.id
WHERE ro.inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId}
ORDER BY COALESCE(ro.received_time, ro.gmt_create) DESC, ro.id DESC

SELECT po.id,
po.putaway_order_no AS no,
po.putaway_status AS status,
po.operator_id AS operatorId,
u.real_name AS operator,
COALESCE(item_summary.putaway_qty, 0) AS qty,
po.putaway_time AS time,
po.gmt_create AS createdTime,
po.remark
FROM putaway_order po
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = po.operator_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT putaway_order_id, SUM(putaway_qty) AS putaway_qty
FROM putaway_order_item
GROUP BY putaway_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.putaway_order_id = po.id
WHERE po.inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId}
ORDER BY COALESCE(po.putaway_time, po.gmt_create) DESC, po.id DESC
